title: Sends the price list as a photo
does: Rosie reads the owner's own list into services, and asks about anything it can't read. It never makes up a price.
more: Each service gets a price kind: one price, per hour, per unit, or set by the customer's answers.
It can also be priced from the customer's photos, set at the visit, or a free estimate.
Extras can be added: a travel fee, an after-hours price, materials at cost and a tax rate.
Or Sam fills in the form in the chat: Apple's Forms in iMessage, or a WhatsApp Flow.
Wedding party grooming is never one list price. Each party is different, so it's priced from photos of the looks.
